acceptance: Each named rewrite has tests on representative queries; execution on duckdb, datafusion (in process), chdb or PySpark where the target dialect has an obtainable engine; others recorded as gaps.
The fork contains no TPC-H query ids or benchmark names; rewrite names are generic.

For DataFusion Q11/Q16/Q18/Q20, the PR states whether a generic rewrite exists; if not, it states the owner decision requested (reclassify as BenchBox query_source variants) instead of merging a partial rewrite.
Output differences versus the BenchBox transformers over their unit-test inputs are listed in the PR.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PRs merged.
description: Expose the pure AST logic of benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dialect_compat.py, cloud_compat.py, core/tpchavoc/spark_query_transformer.py and the DataFusion Q11/Q16/Q18/Q20 transformer as named rewrites taking (expression, dialect, **args). Convert the Snowflake GROUP BY () and BigQuery NULLS LAST text replaces to generator behavior. Variant id sets, qualified-column tables, _BIGQUERY_FROMLESS_IDS and the dispatch table stay in BenchBox. DataFusion Q11 and Q20 are whole-query hand-written replacements (datafusion_query_transformer.py:49-82,136-188): a generic AST version is new decorrelation work, and answers must be validated against TPC-H reference answers, which only BenchBox holds. Expect two PRs.
